T: Halloween Town does Christmas. Badly. Deliciously.
D: The Pumpkin King of Halloween Town discovers Christmas and decides to take it over.
P: Serve the soup when Sally brings Dr Finkelstein his supper.
S: Roast pumpkin mashed with feta, sage and nutmeg, wrapped in shortcrust half moons, a jack-o'-lantern face cut into each, baked at 200C for 20 minutes.
Christmas Town candy cane cheese twists
the bright Christmas Town Jack stumbles into

Puff pastry twisted into candy cane hooks, half coated in smoked paprika and parmesan for the red stripes, baked crisp with a tomato relish dip. Heat the oven to 200C. Brush 2 sheets of puff pastry with beaten egg. Scatter one sheet with 60g grated parmesan and 2 tsp smoked paprika and leave the other plain with a little cheddar. Cut both into 1cm strips. Twist a red strip and a plain strip together, bend the top into a hook and lay on lined trays. Bake 14 minutes until golden. Serve with tomato relish.
Jack's little ghost dog with the glowing nose
Meringue piped into ghostly teardrops, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, a dot of red icing for the glowing nose.
M: the soup Sally makes for the doctor, minus the sleeping potion
Roast pumpkin and carrot soup with garlic and thyme, blended with stock and a little cream, swirled with sour cream in a spiderweb pattern.
Halloween Town beef and pumpkin stew

Beef shin braised dark with pumpkin, carrot, smoked paprika and stock until spoon-soft, served from a black pot with crusty bread. Brown 1.2kg diced beef shin in batches. Soften 1 onion, 2 carrots and 3 garlic cloves. Return the beef, add 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 1 litre beef stock, cover and simmer 2 hours. Add 600g pumpkin chunks and simmer 40 minutes more. Serve with crusty bread and a spoon of sour cream.
W: the bug-filled villain in his lair
Chocolate mousse in cups topped with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and gummy worms crawling out.
K: Cloudy apple juice and blackcurrant simmered with cinnamon, star anise and clove, served deep purple and steaming from a black pot. Pour 1.2 litres cloudy apple juice and 300ml blackcurrant juice into a black pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 3 star anise, 6 cloves and a strip of orange peel. Bring to a simmer and keep just below simmering for 15 minutes. Ladle into mugs with a cinnamon stick.

s.how: Roast 600g diced pumpkin until soft, then mash with crumbled feta, chopped sage and nutmeg. Cut shortcrust into rounds, fill and fold into half moons. Cut a little jack-o'-lantern face into each, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

s.note: Jack's little ghost dog with the glowing nose
s.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with a pinch of cream of tartar to stiff peaks, then add 170g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Pipe ghostly teardrops onto lined trays and bake at 100C for 90 minutes. Cool and add a dot of red icing for the nose.

m.note: the soup Sally makes for the doctor, minus the sleeping potion
m.how: Roast 1kg pumpkin and 3 carrots with garlic and thyme until soft. Blend with 1L hot chicken stock until smooth. Pour into bowls, then pipe circles of sour cream on top and drag a skewer from the centre outwards to make a spiderweb pattern.

w.note: the bug-filled villain in his lair
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in the cream and whites. Spoon into cups, chill, cover with crushed chocolate biscuits and push in gummy worms.

d.how: Pour 1.2 litres cloudy apple juice and 300ml blackcurrant juice into a black pot with 2 cinnamon sticks, 3 star anise, 6 cloves and a strip of orange peel. Bring to a simmer and keep just below simmering for 15 minutes. Ladle into mugs with a cinnamon stick.
